The setting alternates between domestic rooms and clinical hospital-like areas with metal surgical carts. (4) A tall, pale monster with an elongated neck and red pants is seen in a tiled bathroom. (7) The final phase shows a large green monster reflected in a bathroom mirror before a final jump scare with a doll's head flying towards the viewer.
